title: Setup: build Apache POI's poi-ooxml at both #1584 revisions and run TestXSSFHyperlink
description: Setup for case J05 of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-pr-product-behaviour-20-additional-cases.md, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/organic-pr-20/worktrees (J05-poi-fix = c94ee8ad, J05-poi-parent = 72ad1d5e), builds :poi-ooxml:jar (which needs :poi and the XMLBeans schema build of :poi-ooxml-full) with the upstream Gradle 9.9.1 wrapper (wrapper jar and distribution checked against services.gradle.org) on JDK 17.0.21, toolchain auto-download off. The setup session resolved every configuration of :poi, :poi-ooxml-full, :poi-scratchpad and :poi-ooxml online at both revisions first; the first step is online anyway and the rest run --offline. Runs each side's own TestXSSFHyperlink, then the landed file transplanted onto the parent, where the new tests are expected to fail (restored after), then the landed test offline on the fix. Jars and changed-class digests to .../artifacts and the log, JUnit summaries to .../logs, build trees removed. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-pr-product-behaviour-20-additional-cases-setup.md.
expected: every step exits 0: TestXSSFHyperlink passes on both sides' own trees; the transplanted landed test fails on the parent; the offline rerun passes

steps.name: J05-poi-fix: :poi-ooxml:jar online, TestXSSFHyperlink (landed)
J05-poi-parent: :poi-ooxml:jar offline, its own TestXSSFHyperlink
J05-poi-parent: the landed TestXSSFHyperlink transplanted (expected to fail)
J05-poi-fix: TestXSSFHyperlink again, offline
remove the build trees
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; O=$HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/organic-pr-20; W=$O/worktrees; export TMPDIR=$O/tmp GRADLE_USER_HOME=$O/gradle-home; mkdir -p $O/tmp $O/logs $O/artifacts; git -C $W/J05-poi-fix clean -fdxq; git -C $W/J05-poi-parent clean -fdxq; du -sh $W
